basics.title: The Basics
basics.subtitle: Your remote, your phone and Home

remote.title: Arrows move. OK picks. Back goes back.
remote.line2: Hold OK on a channel or a title for more options. You can't break anything.

phone.title: Use your phone as a remote.
phone.line2: Settings → Phone Remote. Scan, then pick Allow on the TV. Your phone can type and talk too.

home.title: This is Home.
home.line2: The big buttons: Live TV, Plex (VOD), Support and the Store.

topbar.title: Top right: the date, the time and your buttons.
topbar.line2: Press Up from the big buttons to reach them.

dashVoice.title: Dashboard is your account. Voice lets you talk to SMC.
dashVoice.line2: Not signed in? The button says Sign In.

ticker.title: The scrolling strip is news from Snow Media.

recommended.title: Recommended: what's on and what to watch.
recommended.line2: Press Up from the big buttons. Left and Right scroll; the dots show the page.

open.title: Open Live TV from Home.
open.line2: It opens where you left off.

signin.title: First time? Sign in with the details from your seller.
signin.line2: Email usernames connect to Vibez; all others to DreamStreams.

services.title: More than one service? They all show in one list.
services.line2: Add one under Live TV Settings → Switch Account. Each has its own heading.

layout.title: Pick your look: Classic, Compact or Vibez.
layout.line2: Live TV asks the first time. Change it in Live TV Settings → Appearance.

menu.title: The menu on the left: Live TV, Guide, Game Day, VOD, Multi-Screen, Backups.

categories.title: Pick a category, then a channel.
categories.line2: Favorites is at the top of the categories.

preview.title: Rest on a channel and it plays in the preview. OK goes full screen.
preview.line2: In the Vibez look, OK plays right away.

search.title: Search finds any channel.
search.line2: Open Search above the list and type the name, or just use Voice.

holdMenu.title: Hold OK on a channel for its options.
holdMenu.line2: Add it to Favorites, report a problem, or record it.

report.title: Reports come straight to Snow Media.
report.line2: Channel down, buffering, no audio or other. ⚠️ shows while we fix it.

watching.title: Live TV: watching
watching.subtitle: The player bar, VOD, Multi-Screen, settings

bar.title: While watching, OK shows the player bar.
bar.line2: Left and Right move along it. The name shows under each button. Back hides it.

channels.title: Up and Down change the channel.
channels.line2: Or use the channel buttons on the bar.

barButtons.title: Report, Subtitles and Audio are on the bar too.
barButtons.line2: Greyed out when the channel has no choice.

top.title: At the top: Update Channels and Settings.
top.line2: Update Channels gets the newest list from your service.

settings.title: Live TV Settings
settings.line2: Account info, switch service, hide categories, the look, rewind and sign out.

vod.title: VOD: your service's movies.
vod.line2: Pick a category, OK on a poster, then Play Movie.

multi.title: Multi-Screen plays 2 or 4 channels at once.
multi.line2: The sound follows the screen you highlight. Each screen uses one stream of your plan.

backups.title: Channel down? Try Backups.
backups.line2: Streams posted by Snow Media. Press Refresh if something was just added.

guide.title: The Guide shows what's on now and next.
guide.line2: OK on a channel plays it. Favorites come first.

rewind.title: Missed something? Back 10s rewinds live TV.
rewind.line2: Go live jumps back to now. It needs a free stream on your plan, or a channel with catch-up.

record.title: Record from the bar, or hold OK on a channel → Record…
record.line2: Pick how long and where: this box or a USB drive.

schedule.title: Hold OK in the Guide to record a show later.
schedule.line2: A red dot marks shows that will record.

recordings.title: Recordings: the button above the channel list.
recordings.line2: OK on one to play, rename or delete it.

settings.title: Rewind & recording settings
settings.line2: Max rewind, and start early / end late for shows you schedule.

gameday.title: Game Day
gameday.subtitle: Today's big games and where they're on

list.title: Game Day lists today's big games.
list.line2: Live TV → Game Day. OK on a game shows where it's on.

links.title: Each channel says which service it's on.
links.line2: "On DreamStreams" or "On Vibez". OK plays it.

picked.title: "Picked by Snow Media" is our pick.
picked.line2: ⚠️ means someone reported it down, so it's listed last.

unconfirmed.title: "Not confirmed by the guide" may not show this game.
unconfirmed.line2: Try the channels above it first.

report.title: Channel not working? Hold OK on it to report it.
report.line2: Reports come straight to Snow Media.

remind.title: Remind me pops up on the TV when the game starts.

open.title: Open Plex (VOD) from Home.
open.line2: Your service's Movies and Series are in the same menu.

connect.title: Signed into Live TV? Plex connects by itself.
connect.line2: If asked, press Connect with Live TV. No Plex account needed.

code.title: Run your own Plex server? Link it with a code.
code.line2: Only for your own server. Snow Media members don't need it.

menu.title: The menu: Home, Discover, your libraries, Search, Request.
menu.line2: Hold OK on a library to hide it.

home.title: Home shows what you were watching and what's new.

discover.title: Not sure what to watch? Try Discover.
discover.line2: Hidden Gems, Surprise Me, genres and decades.

search.title: Search finds any movie or show.

detail.title: OK on a poster opens its page.
detail.line2: Play or Resume, add it to My List, or browse episodes.

versions.title: Some titles come in more than one version.
versions.line2: 4K or 1080p: pick the one that plays best on your internet.

controls.title: OK shows the controls.
controls.line2: Up goes to the seek bar. Left and Right jump.

skip.title: Skip Intro shows at the start of an episode.

next.title: Up next plays the next episode.
next.line2: OK plays it now. Back keeps watching.

audio.title: No sound? Open Audio → Fix audio.
audio.line2: It fixes the sound without restarting.

where.title: Main Apps is in Support.
where.line2: Every extra app you might need, in one safe place.

pick.title: Pick an app and press OK.

store.title: The Snow Media Store.
store.line2: Pick something, then scan the code with your phone to buy it there.

tabs.title: Support has three tabs: Help, AI Chat and Posts.

ai.title: AI Chat answers right away, and can do things for you.
ai.line2: Open a screen, report a channel, install an app, make a wallpaper.

voice.title: Voice: the mic on Home, or your remote's mic button.
voice.line2: Say a channel, a movie, or "open the Guide".

tickets.title: Submit a Ticket reaches a real person.
tickets.line2: A number shows on the Support button when we reply.

speed.title: Speedtest checks your internet.
speed.line2: About 25 Mb/s or more is good for 4K.

buffering.title: TV keeps pausing? The Buffering Guide walks you through the fixes.

posts.title: Posts: news and deals from Snow Media.
posts.line2: New ones are marked New. Links become a code to scan.

more.title: Remote Access and Device Cleaner.
more.line2: A technician can fix your box live. The cleaner frees space and memory.

dashboard.title: The Dashboard: your account on one screen.
dashboard.line2: Open it with Dashboard at the top of Home.

gems.title: Snow Gems pay for Premium AI and Image Gen.

buyGems.title: Buy gems: pick a pack and scan the code with your phone.
buyGems.line2: They land on your account by themselves.

signOut.title: Sign Out is on the Dashboard.
signOut.line2: It signs this box out of your Snow Media account and Live TV.

lounge.title: The Game Lounge: cards, slots, trivia and the Daily Spin.
lounge.line2: Play for Snow Coins. Never real money.

language.title: Change the language: Settings → UI → Language.
language.line2: Every screen and button changes, and so do the AI assistant's answers, Live TV and Plex. Channel and programme names come from the provider.

wallpaper.title: Change your wallpaper in Settings → Media Manager.
wallpaper.line2: Upload your own, or describe one and AI makes it.

switches.title: Settings → UI has the switches.
switches.line2: The Recommended row, Large dashboard, and alerts.

profiles.title: Everyone can have their own profile.
profiles.line2: Their own Continue Watching, My List and favorites. Switch with the profile button on Home.

kids.title: Kids profiles only show what fits their age.
kids.line2: Add a PIN so kids can't open the grown-up profiles.

updates.title: Update available? Settings → Updates installs it.
updates.line2: Home shows "Update available" under the clock.

howTo.title: How to use SMC
howTo.pickTopic: Pick a topic — press Back anytime to leave.

hints.intro: Pick the app that is buffering, then press Next.
hints.step1: Only one channel or title? Report it and we fix it at the source.
hints.step2: Force Stop, then Clear Cache, then press Back to come here.
hints.step3: Aim for 15 Mbps or more on this device.
hints.step4: Install, sign in, Quick Connect, then test again.
hints.summary: Send these results to support if it is still buffering.

kidsHints.step1: Only one channel or title? Tell a grown-up which one.
kidsHints.step2: Ask a grown-up to clear the app's cache.
kidsHints.step4: Ask a grown-up to set up a VPN.
kidsHints.summary: Still buffering? Show this to a grown-up.

buffering.title: Fix Buffering
buffering.skipToVpnTitle: Already tried a VPN? Jump straight to the VPN step.
buffering.skipToVpnBtn: Already tried the rest? Go to the VPN step

kidsOne.title: Tell a grown-up
kidsOne.lead: When only one channel or show fails, it gets fixed at the source. Tell a grown-up which one — they can report it from their profile.

toast.openedSettingsDesc: Tap Force Stop, then Storage → Clear Cache. Press Back when done.
toast.webOnlyDesc: This action only works inside the installed Snow Media Center app.
toast.enterTitleDesc: Type the channel or movie/show name first.
toast.pickDeviceDesc: Tell us which device you are watching on.
toast.reportSentDesc: Thanks! Sign in next time to track it on your account.
toast.openAndroidSettingsDesc: Find the app, then tap Force Stop and Clear Cache.
toast.speedLowDesc: Below 15 Mbps will cause buffering. Try 5GHz Wi-Fi, move closer, or use Ethernet.
toast.switchVpnServerDesc: Pick the closest city/server, then re-test for 15+ Mbps.
toast.getSpeedFirstDesc: Switch VPN city/server, then re-test speed.
toast.awesomeDesc: Likely ISP throttling — keep VPN on while streaming.
toast.enterSpeedDesc: Type the Mbps you saw above, then continue.

anon.title: Send report without signing in?
anon.body1: Your report will be submitted to Snow Media support, but it will <0>not</0> be saved to your account.
anon.body2: Tip: Go back to the Home Screen and tap <0>Sign In</0> first so your ticket is saved on your account and you can track replies.

signInPrompt.title: Sign in to submit a ticket
signInPrompt.body1: You need an account to submit a support ticket so our team can <0>reply back to you</0> and you can track the conversation.
signInPrompt.body2: Sign in or create a free account to submit your ticket and get replies back.

vpnSkip.title: Skip the VPN step?
vpnSkip.body1: Heads up: Your internet provider can slow you down during peak hours — or for no clear reason at all. In 2026, ISP throttling is the <0>#1 cause of buffering</0>.
vpnSkip.body2: If nothing has worked up to this point, installing and turning on a VPN will more than likely fix it. You can still continue if you'd rather skip for now.

intro.title: Which app is buffering?
intro.lead: We'll go through the usual fixes one at a time. This is for Snow Media's streaming apps — Netflix, Disney+ or Hulu buffering is usually something else.

report.title: Report the channel or title
report.lead: Tell us exactly what's buffering in <0>{{appLabel}}</0> and what you watch on. We'll open a support ticket so it gets fixed at the source.
report.namePlaceholder: e.g. ESPN HD, The Bear S03E01
report.deviceQuestion: Which device are you watching on?

step1.title: Is it one channel, or everything?
step1.lead: When only one channel or title fails, your internet is usually fine — it's the source, and we can fix that on our end.
step1.oneSub: Report it and we'll fix it

step2.title: Refresh {{app}}
step2.lead: Clearing the app's cache fixes a lot of buffering. It doesn't sign you out or delete anything.
step2.kidsNote: Ask a grown-up to do this part. In the box's settings for {{app}}: <0>Force Stop</0>, then <1>Storage → Clear Cache</1>.
step2.item2: Go to <0>Storage → Clear Cache</0> (not Clear Data)
step2.item3: Press <0>Back</0> on your remote to come here
step2.notInstalled: {{app}} doesn't look installed on this device. Install it from Main Apps first.
step2.question: Did that fix the buffering?
step2.stillSub: Next we'll test your internet speed

step3.title: Test your internet speed
step3.lead: Streaming needs at least 15 Mbps download on this device. Run the test here, or type in a result from another speed test.
step3.tooSlow: Too slow for smooth streaming. Try 5 GHz Wi-Fi, move the box closer to the router, or use an Ethernet cable, then test again.
step3.emptyHint: Run the test and your result shows here.

step4.title: Try a VPN
step4.lead: Internet providers often slow streaming down, especially in the evening. A VPN hides your streaming from them, and is the most common fix.
step4.kidsNote: A VPN is a grown-up's job. Ask one to set it up and turn it on, then come back and try your stream again.
step4.runVpnBtn: Run speed test with VPN on
step4.speedLowSub: Pick a closer VPN city, then test again

vpn.item1: <0>Sign in</0> — your reseller has the details, or sign up with the QR code
vpn.item2: Choose <0>Quick Connect</0>, then come back and try your stream
vpn.paidNote: A VPN is a paid service — free ones are too slow for streaming. It does <0>not</0> work with VibezTV.
vpn.scanToSignUp: Scan with your phone to sign up

summary.kidsNote: Still buffering? Show this screen to a grown-up. They can send it to support from their profile.

oneOnly.title: It's that one channel or title
oneOnly.b1: If only one channel/title is failing, your internet is usually fine.
oneOnly.b2: Email the exact channel/title name to support so we can fix it fast.

cacheFixed.title: Fixed: clearing the cache did it
cacheFixed.b1: Clearing cache + restarting refreshes the app and connection.
cacheFixed.b2: If it happens again, repeat the Force Stop + Clear Cache step first.

slow.title: Your internet is too slow on this device
slow.b1: Speed on the streaming device is under 15 Mbps ({{speed}} Mbps).
slow.b2: Switch to 5GHz Wi-Fi, move closer, or try Ethernet.

vpnFixed.title: Fixed: your provider was slowing you down
vpnFixed.b1: VPN working means your ISP likely slowed streaming traffic (especially during peak hours).
vpnFixed.b2: Keep VPN on while streaming and use a nearby/fast server.
vpnFixed.b3: If speed drops with VPN, choose the closest VPN city/server and re-test (15+ Mbps).

still.title: Still buffering: let's get support on it
still.b1: Re-check speed test closer to the router (15+ Mbps).
still.b2: Try VPN with a different nearby city/server and re-test speed (15+ Mbps).
still.b3: Press Send to support and we will pick it up from your results.
